description: MERCHANT RANK: NOVICE. Easy to exploit. (e.g. Street vendors, beggars)
MERCHANT RANK: APPRENTICE. (e.g. General Goods stores in small villages)
MERCHANT RANK: ADEPT. Standard Merchants. (e.g. Whiterun Market)
MERCHANT RANK: EXPERT. Tough negotiators. (e.g. Blacksmiths, Court Wizards)
MERCHANT RANK: MASTER. The best in Skyrim. (e.g. East Empire Company, Ri'saad)
